subject: CWE-74
object: The product constructs all or part of a command, data structure, or record using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify how it is parsed or interpreted when it is sent to a downstream component.

subject: CWE-20
object:

        properties that are required to process the data safely and
        correctly.
